**Finding submitted: deviation on Section 15 (Assignment or Transfer), paragraph p0080.**

- **Investigation:** Section 15 is the only assignment provision in the agreement; targeted searches for "change of control", "successor/merger/substantially all assets", and termination triggers returned no other responsive language, so there is no Vendor change-of-control exit to delete.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no successor/M&A carve-out for either party, no written-notice mechanic, no "not unreasonably withheld" standard on the consent that is required, and the retained mutual no-consent affiliate exception means not every non-successor assignment requires consent.
- **Cure (preferred level, two ops):** one surgical replace making Client's assignment rights free for affiliates and M&A successors while binding TrueLink to Client consent (not unreasonably withheld) and barring assignment to a Client competitor; one short inserted sentence confirming a Client change of control gives TrueLink no termination right. This keeps our existing affiliate freedom rather than surrendering it to reach the mutual fallback.
